channel.title: Mullvad Causing Panel Crash
channel.description: Recently a bug has appeared when I am using mullvad browser. It causes my panel to crash/disappear and I get a popup saying panel has crashed too many times, auto restart has been disabled until next login.

item.title: Mullvad Causing Panel Crash

item.description:
Might be a Mullvad Browser bug. If you boot into sysmaint mode and run sudo journalctl | grep 'segfault', do you see crashes attributed to lxqt-panel? If so, can you share the output lines here?
